svg.title: A KERNAL file is saved twice
svg.desc: Two cases drawn as rows of byte cells. First, a good first copy and a repeat with its last bytes lost: the repeat is written again from the first copy. Second, two copies each with different bytes lost: lined up and merged into one whole block whose checksum passes.
svg.text: A KERNAL file is saved twice
Every block goes onto the tape, then again: a countdown $89…$81 before the first copy, $09…$01 before the repeat.
→ the repeat is written again from the first copy, at full length, so nothing after it moves
→ the copies are lined up, and each lost byte is taken from the other copy;
the block's checksum decides whether the merge is the file
